content.title: Hover a performance point to inspect the custom tooltip
content.intent: Prove hovering a chart point shows the custom tooltip near the active point, updates the displayed date, portfolio value, benchmark value, and return, and leaves summary cards unchanged.
content.technique_notes: State/flow applied because the chart moves from unhovered to hovered state and the outcome includes both newly visible hover data and a non-changing dashboard summary. Negative/error reasoning applied to the forbidden summary-card drift and forbidden default-tooltip behavior.
